title: Z-Axis Stuttering & Abnormal Noise Fix - Hydra Series
body_html:
Stuttering and Abnormal Noise When Moving Platform (Z-Axis) - Hydra Series

This page provides a comprehensive troubleshooting guide for resolving stuttering, abnormal noise, or jamming issues when the Z-axis platform moves up or down. It outlines common symptoms, root causes, and step-by-step corrective actions to restore normal Z-axis operation.

Problem Description

  • Stuttering or abnormal noise occurs when moving the Z-axis up or down.
  • The platform stalls at a specific height and cannot move further upward.
  • Physical resistance or strange sounds are noticed when manually pulling the Z-axis belt.

Cause

  • Alignment Issues: One of the Z-axis lead screws is not perfectly vertical or parallel.
  • Driver Settings: Incorrect DIP switch positions on the Z-axis driver.
  • Parameter Errors: Incorrect factory parameter settings in the software.

Solution

Method 1. Inspect and Align the Z-Axis Lead Screws

This issue typically occurs in new machines or after a significant physical impact that causes the lead screws to bend or shift out of vertical alignment.

  • Open the front bottom door panel and check the four lead screws for any visible bending.
  • To ensure the lead screws are parallel, measure the distance between the lead screws as shown in the diagram (Sides A, B, and C).
  • To measure Side B, you must first remove the metal protective plate.
  • The lengths of sides with the same color (e.g. all A sides, all B sides, all C sides) should be identical. It is normal for Sides B and Sides C to have different values.
  • Measure from the edge of one lead screw base to the edge of the opposite lead screw base.
  • If you find a side with an inconsistent length, loosen the two screws on the black base, slightly adjust the position until the measurements match, and then retighten the screws.

 

Method 2. Check the Z-Axis Driver DIP Switches

  • Open the bottom door panel on the right side of the machine.
  • Locate the Z-axis driver (usually positioned toward the top left).
  • Ensure that only switches 2, 3, and 7 are in the ON (pressed down) position. All other switches must be in the OFF position.

 

Method 3. Verify Factory Parameters

  • Open LightBurn and navigate to Machine Settings. Then locate the Z Axis Settings section.
  • Check if your parameters match the standard values (see reference image). If the values do not match, please contact the OneLaser after-sales team to obtain the correct parameter values.

 

Important Reminder:

If these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on ZOHO: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket. A technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
